scope: Fresh production human OIDC sign-in and browser refresh acceptance only

method.action: Selected Continue to identity provider after the user authenticated in Pocket ID

observed.initialRefreshObservation: Transient initialization had neither identity nor login form; subsequent full accessibility observation showed the owner workspace and CONNECTED

evidence.source: Direct browser accessibility observations before and after refresh, plus a private local screenshot

limitations: This proves the current human sign-in callback, owner workspace loading, refresh persistence and displayed realtime connection only.
It does not prove global DNS propagation, new server IP, external Agent execution, multiple real users, cloud inference or sustained Relay quality.
Prior external-browser login evidence remains historical and is not rewritten by this observation.
